required_state_fields.description: Delivery goal including the user's acceptance conditions.

required_state_fields.name: actual_completion
required_state_fields.description: What was actually completed against the delivery goal.

required_state_fields.name: verification_evidence.verified
required_state_fields.description: Verification evidence that was actually verified; [] when there is none.

required_state_fields.name: verification_evidence.unverified
required_state_fields.description: Evidence that is not verified (or was not run); [] means a verified none, never a missing fact.

required_state_fields.name: unfinished_impact
required_state_fields.description: Unfinished items and their impact; [] means nothing is unfinished, never a missing fact.

questions.instructions: 按交付目标、实际完成与验证证据判断：这次交付可以收尾，还是需要继续完成，或交用户确认？不以任务数量或完成声明代替证据。

labels.finalize: 可以收尾：按交付目标与验收条件直接签收
labels.continue: 继续完成：交 PM 推进未完成的缺口
labels.user-confirm: 交用户确认：由 PM 提出具体待确认项
